title: ALMA Imaging and Gravitational Lens Models of South Pole Telescope—Selected Dusty, Star-Forming Galaxies at High Redshifts
question: What are the lens models, magnifications and intrinsic sizes of SPT-selected lensed DSFGs, and what do the sizes imply for the size distribution, dust optical depth wavelength and [CII]/FIR ratio?

evidence.quote: Source redshifts are given in (cite: weiss13) and Strandet et al.(submitted). Lens redshifts are given in Rotermund et al., in prep.
We perform the fitting described using the source photometry in (cite: weiss13; strandet16), and an MCMC fitting routine.
(cite: simpson15b) measure sizes of 22 sources based on 870 $\mu\rm{m}$ ALMA imaging
for both the SPT sample and the *Herschel*-selected samples of (cite: bussmann13; bussmann15)
the slope is exactly as determined by (cite: diazsantos13), i.e., $[C{\scriptsize II}]/\ensuremath{L_{\rm{FIR}}}\propto \ensuremath{\Sigma_{\rm{FIR}}}^{-0.35}$.

recipe.method: Standard calibration with quasar bandpass/phase calibrators; visibility noise from differencing successive visibilities; tracks combined

SIE lenses (plus optional shear) and point-source or Sersic background components; model image Fourier transformed and sampled at data uv points; chi^2 likelihood; free amplitude rescaling, astrometric offset and antenna phase errors
Taper at 50 klambda, CLEAN, sum components, compare to LABOCA

recipe.goal: Compare lensed vs unlensed size distributions
recipe.method: Two-sample K-S test of sizes of strongly lensed (mu>2) SPT and Herschel sources vs unlensed samples

recipe.goal: Fit modified blackbody SED to constrain lambda0
recipe.method: Fit rest wavelengths >50 um with modified blackbody with free normalization, Tdust, lambda0; likelihood includes lens-model intrinsic flux and size at 870 um; lambda0-Tdust relation by orthogonal distance regression with outlier marginalization
assumptions: Uniform source emission with single Tdust and lambda0

recipe.method: Refit photometry for uniform LFIR, compute Sigma_FIR from lens-model sizes, compare with GOALS relation

evidence.quote: with a median magnification of 5.5 for all sources, or 6.3 for the strongly lensed subset alone
with a median magnification of 5.5 for all sources
We find a median Einstein radius of 0.64$''$
for 38 sources (81%), strong gravitational lensing is the most plausible explanation for the ALMA emission
We recover a median of ($91\pm24$)% of the LABOCA flux density
We find a median intrinsic FWHM of 0.28”.

answer_key.quantity: K-S p-value lensed vs unlensed sizes

evidence.quote: We find a median value of $\lambda_0$= 140 $\pm$ 40 $\mu\rm{m}$
only 13% (6/47) of sources contain multiple components at $>5\sigma$ significance
